en: The Question on Knowing the Supreme State of the Buddha
“Venerable Nāgasena, is it possible to know that ‘the Buddha is unsurpassed’?
“Yes, Great King, it is possible to know that ‘the Blessed One is unsurpassed.’”
“How, venerable Nāgasena, can it be known that ‘the Buddha is unsurpassed’?
“Once upon a time, great king, there was a teacher of writing named the Elder Tissa. When many years had passed since his death, how would he be known?
“In the same way, O Great King, he who sees the Dhamma sees the Blessed One; for the Dhamma, O Great King, has been taught by the Blessed One.
This was the third question, concerning the knowledge of the Buddha’s unsurpassed state.
